usage: 健身 can be used as a verb meaning 'to work out' or 'to exercise'.
It can also function as a noun referring to the activity of fitness or working out itself.
健身 is often combined with locations or times to specify when or where the workout happens, like 健身房 (gym).
When using 健身 as a verb, you can add 時間 (time) or 頻率 (frequency) words to describe how often you work out.
健身 typically involves physical activities aimed at improving health, so it’s common in conversations about health routines.
